messages.text:
"Create a 3D mobile sandbox simulation game for Android titled \"Model Crash Sandbox\". 

Core Concept: 
Players enter a workshop mode to choose scale models (such as vintage cars or military airplanes), customize them by attaching solid-fuel model rockets and explosive charges (like C4 and detonators) onto specific structural parts, and then launch a physical test simulation to witness the destruction.

Key Systems @COMMENT_BODY@ Mechanics:
1. Workshop / Assembly Mode: An intuitive touch-based UI where players can select a model and drag-and-drop rockets and explosive charges onto custom placement nodes.
2. Real-World Physics @COMMENT_BODY@ Destruction: Realistic rigid-body physics where models dynamically shatter into multiple debris pieces upon detonation. Explosion forces must apply radial impulses to all fragments, sending shrapnel flying and leaving procedural scorching or burn marks on nearby surfaces.
3. Cinematic Slow-Motion Camera: Upon explosion, the game automatically shifts into a high-speed \"Phantom camera\" slow-motion effect with time dilation, accompanied by dynamic camera shake and zoom to capture the action.
4. Visual Effects (VFX): Optimized mobile-friendly GPU particle systems rendering dense volumetric black smoke, bright fiery orange explosions, glowing sparks, and fiery propulsion trails.

Technical @COMMENT_BODY@ UI Requirements:
- Designed for Android touch controls (pinch-to-zoom, orbit camera rotation, drag-and-drop UI).
- Optimized performance targeting a stable 60 FPS on mobile devices through efficient mesh fracturing and particle pooling.
- Clean, immersive layout with a clear toggle between the Customization phase and the Simulation/Test phase.


---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
